status: Exploratory simulation-only controller; not flashed to robot
selected_training_method: Behavior cloning from successful simulated demonstrations; PPO refinement candidates were worse on development evaluation
timing_note: Times exclude 0.8 s initial settling and include the required 1 s upright dwell
limitations: One training seed, finite simulated test sets; no guarantee of always recovering

Exact simulated gravity plus noise is used; real IMU estimator/alignment is not integrated
Servo/PWM mapping, joint limits, hardware distribution and dynamics remain uncalibrated
Adjacent contacts remain excluded dynamically; a separate snapshot audit ignores pivot mating regions
